name: golden-dataset-v1
description: Reviewed 20-case demonstration golden dataset over the three RAGbench-MY demonstration sources (see db/fixtures/golden_dataset_v1_README.txt). Reference unit: document.

cases.question: How many approval stages does an expenditure request go through?
cases.reference_answer: Three: technical review by the division cost officer, certification by the head of finance, and counter-signature by the controlling officer.

cases.question: When does the ministry tender board convene for large requests?
cases.reference_answer: For requests above RM 500,000 the tender board must convene within five working days of technical review.

cases.question: What is the direct-purchase threshold and what is required between it and RM 100,000?
cases.reference_answer: Direct purchase up to RM 5,000; between RM 5,000 and RM 100,000, at least three quotations are required.

cases.question: When is open tender mandatory?
cases.reference_answer: Above RM 100,000 open tender applies.

cases.question: Can emergency procurement bypass open tender, and what must be reported?
cases.reference_answer: Yes, with written justification; the commitment must be reported to the audit committee within 14 days.

cases.question: What is the annual budget submission deadline and what happens to a late submission?
cases.reference_answer: Two months before fiscal year start; a late submission is returned once for correction, then escalated to the controlling officer.

cases.question: Does the guidelines require a board meeting for any expenditure request?
cases.reference_answer: Yes: for requests above RM 500,000 the ministry tender board must convene within five working days of technical review.

cases.question: What must a data sharing agreement contain at minimum?
cases.reference_answer: The dataset owner, permitted purposes, and a review date no later than 24 months after signature.

cases.question: How are datasets containing personal data handled before sharing?
cases.reference_answer: They must first pass an anonymisation review; de-identified logs keep latencies and totals but drop identifiers, free-text remarks, and device fingerprints.

cases.question: How long do shared extracts remain valid?
cases.reference_answer: 90 days after the review date unless the agreement is renewed; expired extracts are deleted and the deletion recorded.

cases.question: How often is the register of active agreements reviewed?
cases.reference_answer: Quarterly.

cases.question: What is the review date limit on a data sharing agreement?
cases.reference_answer: No later than 24 months after signature.

cases.question: What happens to an expired extract?
cases.reference_answer: It is deleted and the deletion is recorded in the register.

cases.question: Does the data sharing policy regulate personal data between departments directly?
cases.reference_answer: No; personal data must pass anonymisation review first.

cases.question: How many paid leave days per year are staff entitled to?
cases.reference_answer: 21 paid leave days per year, with up to 5 carried forward.

cases.question: How early must a leave application be lodged?
cases.reference_answer: At least 12 working days before the first day of leave.

cases.question: When is performance reviewed during probation?
cases.reference_answer: Twice, at month two and month four of the six-month probation.

cases.question: Can carried-forward leave be paid out in cash?
cases.reference_answer: No; carried-forward days are credited to work only.

cases.question: What additional approval does leave longer than 10 consecutive days need?
cases.reference_answer: Counter-approval by the department head.

cases.question: How many paid sick leave days apply during probation?
cases.reference_answer: Up to 10.
